title: Datatechnician
description: Rotated across six specialist teams over 3.5 years, gaining broad hands-on experience across cloud platforms, enterprise infrastructure, networking, identity, and IT security.
cv_bullets: Mail & Azure Team (1.5 years) — Administered the full Office 365 platform including Teams, OneDrive, Exchange Online, and on-prem Exchange. Handled SharePoint admin work in the context of Teams. Involved in Azure administration and development, contributing to Landing Zone Vending, Service Principal Vending, VNET Vending, Firewall Rules management, Policy Exemption management, and an Azure Notification System built on Azure Communication Services
LABIT — Laboratory IT (1 year) — Supported laboratory IT systems across the university. Introduced to Ceph distributed storage and OpenNebula hypervisor for managing lab compute infrastructure

Active Directory Team (6 months) — Maintained Active Directory and internal PKI infrastructure. Handled routine certificate issuance, key rotation, scheduled backups, and LAPS key recovery for data retrieval tasks

Networking Team (6 months) — Worked with Cisco ISE and Cisco DNA Center for automated deployment of new networking equipment. Handled on-site networking tasks including troubleshooting broken links and cabling up new equipment. Led development of a new platform for the device network (95% complete at rotation)

IT Security Team (6 months) — Audited and triaged all Azure Sentinel analytics rules, identifying and removing unused rules. Investigated abnormally high Sentinel log ingestion costs — identified the root cause and collaborated with the AD Team to overhaul the log ingestion pipeline, reducing daily ingest from ~80 GB to ~10 GB. Involved in MAM policy work, tiering projects, and an ongoing Power BI reporting project based on Sentinel log analytics data

title: IT Support Specialist
description: 1st tier helpdesk support for staff and students across the university. Resolved hardware, software, and network issues, and provided on-site technical support during DTU exams. Progressed into the Datatechnician role after 1 year.

title: Senior Administrator & Developer
description: Primary administrator and developer for a veterans-focused online community. Responsible for the full infrastructure stack including websites, forums, databases, Linux servers, mail, Docker containers, an operations platform (OpServ), and social media integrations across Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, and Twitch.
